Chapter 302: Chapter 8 Great Scholar Tai'E: Which Evolution Scholar Are You? (Subscription Request)_2

Chapter 302: Chapter 8 Great Scholar Tai’e: Which Evolution Scholar Are You? (Subscription Request)_2

This type of special life’s blood essence potion was highly sought after within the Human Civilization, and once available, it was quickly sold out.

One could hardly imagine how many three-headed ice wolves would have to be drained to create such a blood essence potion.

“These are all yours now.”

The indifferent man still had his back to Lin Yuan.

“Thank you, Senior.”

Lin Yuan’s expression was solemn as he spoke earnestly.

...

Although it was true that any member of the Human Race who found this spatial entrance and entered would receive a gift from the indifferent man,

Lin Yuan had indeed received a great benefit.

“I wonder if there’s anything you’d like me to do, Senior?”

Lin Yuan attempted cautiously.

“Anything?”

The indifferent man was slightly startled, then he smiled and said, “I have been dead for so long; I no longer have old friends, so there’s nothing much I need …”

Boom.

At that moment,

the small space where Lin Yuan was began to shake.

“You better leave quickly.”

“This small space is about to collapse.”

The indifferent man raised his right hand.

A streak of flowing light shot out and landed in Lin Yuan’s hand.

It was a storage bracelet.

Inside were many treasures belonging to the indifferent man, ‘Ou Yin.’

“Yes.”

Lin Yuan took the storage bracelet and immediately flew toward the entrance.

The indifferent man, Ou Yin, watched Lin Yuan’s departing figure as his body began to crumble quickly.

“Wangyue Starfield… Tianchen Star…”

The indifferent man, Ou Yin, murmured softly, then in the next moment, he completely disintegrated.

…

Chikun Main Star.

Thirteen Peaks Great Hall.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

About everything that the Radiant Yang Spirit had experienced, Lin Yuan naturally ‘synchronized’ his knowledge, sharing one consciousness, and could switch perspectives at any time.

“The battlefields of different races are fraught with danger. Aside from supreme beings, no one can ensure their survival …”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

The experiences of the Eighth Layer Evolutionist, Ou Yin, made him cautious.

Even a small-sized otherworldly battlefield like Battlefield C24763 could cause an Eighth Layer Evolutionist to stumble.

“But … today’s Human Civilization is much better than before …”

Lin Yuan’s expression became slightly emotional.

In the era of Ou Yin, the Human Civilization Alliance had difficulties in wars against many different races around them, and in many aspects like foundation and support, they seemed somewhat lacking.

The most obvious example was that the Doppelganger Skill was exceedingly rare during that time. Even Eighth Layer Evolutionist Ou Yin had not cultivated a doppelganger.

Unlike now, where just the Doppelganger Skills listed under the Red Kun Lineage number over ten.

Although cultivating a doppelganger skill requires sacrificing a small portion of the soul and not every Evolver is suitable for cultivating one,

it is much stronger than tens of thousands of years ago.

…

“Never mind.”

“Let’s continue cultivating.”

After a moment of reflection, Lin Yuan immersed himself once again in contemplating the spatial model.

Aside from cultivating, Lin Yuan occasionally connected to the Virtual World to interact with other Evolvers.

The clash of different perspectives and the combination of their Against-Heaven’s Understanding often unexpectedly helped Lin Yuan.

“This person’s insights… might not be inferior to my teacher’s”

Lin Yuan entered the founders’ circle of the Virtual World and chatted briefly with a founder named ‘Tai’e,’ thinking to himself.

Lin Yuan and this ‘Tai’e’ met through a post titled ‘Is it better to understand one rule deeply or many rules more superficially?’

This post, from 23,000 years ago, was left on the founders’ forum by the founder ‘Tai’e.’

Lin Yuan often communicated with him, faintly feeling that ‘Tai’e’ had broad vision.

However, Lin Yuan tried searching the Virtual World network but couldn’t find any information related to ‘Tai’e.’

While Lin Yuan was pondering,

the founder named ‘Tai’e’ sent another message.

“Many evolutionary paths of Human Civilization, which stage do you think is the most important?”

After reading this message, Lin Yuan pondered.

From the First to Sixth Ranks of the Martial Tao Evolution Path and even up to the Seventh Rank Lin Yuan was currently deciphering, plenty of information flashed through his mind.

“The Seventh Rank.”

After thinking it over, Lin Yuan responded.

With deeper understanding of more and more basic spatial models,

Lin Yuan was gradually perceiving the specific direction of the Seventh Stage Martial Tao Chapter.

Once Lin Yuan truly opened the Seventh Rank Chapter, his transformation would far surpass the previous six ranks.

…

“He should be back soon, right?”

After replying to ‘Tai’e,’ Lin Yuan glanced in the direction of the alien battlefield.

According to Lin Yuan’s plan, he had sent his Radiant Yang Spirit to the battlefield of the different races to perceive the rules of spatial fluctuations.

However, plans always fall behind changes.

Lin Yuan intended to stay out of worldly affairs and avoid contact with other species, but instead, he gained the inheritance of an Eighth Layer Evolutionist.

Even on a medium-sized otherworldly battlefield, obtaining the inheritance of a treasure belonging to an Eighth Layer powerhouse was an extremely rare opportunity.

Lin Yuan had never considered this possibility because the chances were simply too low.

But since it happened, Lin Yuan could only reluctantly accept it.

In this situation, leaving that inheritance from the Eighth Layer Evolutionist, Ou Yin, in the possession of the Radiant Yang Spirit, and then letting the Radiant Yang Spirit stay in the perilous battlefield of different races,

Lin Yuan found himself unable to sleep.

He would not mind if the Radiant Yang Spirit perished, as it could be reformed in some time.

But the loss of the Eighth Layer Evolutionist’s treasure, the Eighth Layer armor, and the soul defense weapon, and a thousand cubic universe crystals …

If these were to be lost along with the fall of the Radiant Yang Spirit, Lin Yuan reckoned it would distress him for a long time.

So right after the Radiant Yang Spirit left that small space, Lin Yuan instructed him to hurry back, deposit the many treasures with him, and then continue to the alien battlefield.
